card.name: Quantity words after 'more than' or 'too'
card.fires_on: The word 'one' right after 'more than', and 'many' after 'Too', where a count or limit is about to be named. Also 'over' in 'all over the place'.

modes.label: more than one
modes.description: 'one' directly after 'more than' or 'not more than', before a unit such as tablet, pad, week or teacher.
modes.example: • Avoid administration of more than<< one>> NSAID at a time.

modes.label: Too many
modes.description: 'many' after a sentence-opening 'Too', before a plural noun.
modes.example: Too<< many>> anaerobes can cause bacterial vag

modes.label: all over
modes.description: 'over' in the phrase 'all over the place'.
modes.example: Our thoughts are all<< over>> the place and the whole subject just feels
